title: Location page
description: The business in one town or area: what it does there, what customers there say, the questions they ask, and how to reach it from there.

copy_guidance.Eyebrow: The area's name, or the region it sits in.
copy_guidance.Heading: The service and the town or area this page is for, as a customer would search for it.
copy_guidance.Body: One line on the work the business does in this area. How long it has worked there is a claim: leave it out unless the site owner gave it.
copy_guidance.Primary button: The main action, such as Get a quote.

copy_guidance.Heading: What the business does in this area, in a few words.
copy_guidance.Intro: One line on the services offered here, when they differ from the full list.

copy_guidance.Heading: What customers in this area say, in a few words. No count or score.
copy_guidance.Review 1 detail: The customer's town, or the service, as the site owner gave it.

copy_guidance.Heading: The places around this area the business also covers, in a few words.
copy_guidance.Intro: One line on how to ask about a town near this one that the list leaves out.

copy_guidance.Heading: A short question that asks a visitor in this area to get in touch.
copy_guidance.Body: What happens once they get in touch, as the site owner describes it.

copy_guidance.Heading: Questions from customers in this area, in a few words.
copy_guidance.Question 1: Whether the business works in this town or area, as a visitor would ask it.
copy_guidance.Question 1 answer: Which parts of the area it covers, as Site Data's service area or the site owner gives it.

copy_guidance.Heading: An invitation to get in touch from this area, in a few words.
copy_guidance.Form heading: What a visitor in this area can send, in a few words.
